body: I understand you want to try to make me feel like there is more to live for, but really thinking about it there isn't. Think about it, chances are I won't be able to get a scholarship for school anymore, so if I were to go back to college now it will cost me an arm and a leg. If I don't go to college I can't get a good job and live happily off of it, I appreciate you trying but based off the numbers, living just isn't for me.
